correctness.rationale: Polarizing the cubic in characteristic 2 gives L^[2]=L^perp, whence L^[4]=L and descent to F4. The Hermitian isotropic spaces are pairing codes if they contain a weight-two vector (split off the pair and use the length-four Singleton bound), and otherwise their systematic generator is the unique normalized hexacode matrix. At each point in the [I|A] chart the last three linear forms are a basis, and the differential has image exactly the nine monomials with a repeated variable. The integral hexacode restriction is 4(u^3+v^3+w^3)+18uvw, whose uvw coefficient cannot be changed modulo 4 by any correction. Eliminating nine equations by the invertible Jacobian yields R/(g); the pairing sections imply g=0, and nonexistence of a mod-4 lift implies v_2(g)=1 at every hexacode point. Properness and finite fibers give finiteness, and Henselian splitting assembles the local factors. Independently enumerating Hermitian orthonormal frames in each systematic chart gave 405 and 486 points, verified all four incidence rows by vector-set intersections, and exact ring expansion verified the obstruction coefficient. The finite check does not itself prove the scheme decomposition.
residual_risks: The relative conclusion is specific to the displayed integral cubic and base DVR.

value.rationale: The scheme of planes of a smooth arithmetic cubic is a natural enumerative and deformation-theoretic object. The result distinguishes actual horizontal sections from vertical reduced points, measuring the missing lifts at the first infinitesimal stage rather than merely subtracting two counts. The incidence refinement makes the position of the liftable planes within the established Hermitian configuration explicit.
residual_risks: Value is an exact degeneration for this model, not a classification of such degenerations for arbitrary cubics.
